title: Chaand har second Earth pe gir raha hai
description: Season 2 Episode 2: An orbit is falling so fast sideways that you keep missing the ground.
ncert_chapter: NCERT XI Ch 7 (orbital motion, centripetal acceleration)
belief_card_text: CHEESEIN ZAMEEN KO MISS KARTI HAIN?
takeaway: Moon falls 1.4 mm/s, but moves 1 km/s sideways!
teaser_question: ESCAPE VELOCITY: Earth chhodne ke liye kitni speed?
hook_text: Moon har second 1.4 mm GIRTA hai 🌙
concept: An orbit is falling so fast sideways that you keep missing the ground.
on_screen_cues: ball thrown harder ×3 (drawings) → "ORBIT = girna + miss karna" → "Moon: 1.4 mm/s down, 1 km/s sideways" → "NCERT XI · Ch 7"
pinned_comment: Agar Moon achanak RUK jaaye... kya hoga? 🤔 (Hint: 5 din)
suggested_titles: "Moon Earth pe kyun nahi girta? (Woh gir raha hai!)" / "Orbit kya hai? 60 second mein"
elevenlabs_script:
Gudiya: [curious] Chintu, tumne bola cheezein zameen ko "miss" kar jaati hain. Matlab kya?
Chintu: [excited] Ek ball seedha chhodo, neeche girti hai. Ab usse zor se aage phenko?
Gudiya: [confidently] Aage jaake girti hai. Obviously.
Chintu: [mischievously] Aur zor se phenko?
Gudiya: [thoughtful] Aur aage jaake girti hai...
Chintu: [dramatic tone] Ab ITNI zor se phenko ki jitna woh girti hai, utni hi zameen neeche curve ho jaaye!
Gudiya: [gasps] Toh woh kabhi zameen pe pahunchegi hi nahi?!
Chintu: [excited] Exactly! Woh girti rahegi... aur Earth ka chakkar lagaati rahegi. Isko bolte hain ORBIT!
Gudiya: [surprised] Toh Moon bhi?
Chintu: [excited] Moon har second Earth ki taraf 1 point 4 millimetre girta hai!
Gudiya: [confused] Bas 1 point 4 millimetre?
Chintu: [cheerfully] Haan! Lekin saath mein 1 kilometre per second se side mein bhaag raha hai. Toh girta hai, par miss karta hai. Har second. 4 arab saal se!
Gudiya: [elated] Matlab Moon gir rahe hue Earth ko miss kar raha hai?! Itna simple?!
Chintu: [proudly] Newton ne yahi socha tha. 1687 mein.
Gudiya: [curious] Toh kitni speed chahiye Earth ko hamesha ke liye chhodne ke liye?
Chintu: [mischievously] Woh next video mein!
